title: How do we expand six expressions with brackets?
description: Six expressions with brackets are multiplied out, each term with each term, keeping every sign. One result is checked by putting numbers back in.
teaching_notes: One idea: every term multiplies every term and each sign stays with its term. Same method as the take away example in your book. Watch for lost signs when a negative term multiplies a negative term.

video_script.why: The child has expanded brackets with signs. Here six expressions of different shapes use the same method.
video_script.substitution: Multiply every term of the first bracket with every term of the second, keep each sign, and add the like terms.
video_script.anchor: six expressions with brackets, shown on the board together
video_script.payoff_line: Every term multiplies every term, and each sign stays with its term

final_answer.spoken: the first is three v minus three u plus u v minus nine, and the second is ten plus four eigh

never_show: a sign dropped from a negative term
maths_rules: check the first with u = 2, v = 5: 5 × 2 = 10 and 15 − 6 + 10 − 9 = 10
video_script.design: One idea: every term multiplies every term, with its sign. Uses the method of the take away video. The six expressions stay on the stage while the working builds up.

narration: <bookmark mark='all'/>Each term of the first bracket multiplies each term of the second.
<bookmark mark='sign'/>A sign stays with its term, so take care with the minus signs.
<bookmark mark='num'/>A number outside a bracket multiplies each term inside.

marks.given: the six expressions are written in a row

narration: <bookmark mark='given'/>Given, six expressions with brackets.

beats.on_screen: To find: each one expanded and simplified

marks.find: the words expanded and simplified are written as the thing to find

narration: <bookmark mark='find'/>We have to expand each one and simplify it.

marks.m2: u × v and u × (−3) are written: + uv − 3u
marks.m3: 3v − 3u + uv − 9 is written as the neat result

beats.colours: each pair of pieces in its own colour
narration: <bookmark mark='m1'/>Step one, take the bracket three plus u times the bracket v minus three.
Multiply three by v and by minus three.
<bookmark mark='m2'/>Then multiply u by v and by minus three.
<bookmark mark='m3'/>That gives three v, minus nine, plus u v, minus three u.
Written neatly, it is three v minus three u plus u v minus nine.
<bookmark mark='f1'/>Step two, take two thirds times the bracket fifteen plus six eigh.
Two thirds of fifteen is ten.
<bookmark mark='f2'/>Two thirds of six eigh is four eigh.
<bookmark mark='f3'/>The result is ten plus four eigh.

marks.g2: b × 10c = 10bc and b × d = bd are written

narration: <bookmark mark='g1'/>Step three, take ten eigh plus b times ten c plus d. Ten eigh times ten c is one hundred eigh c.
<bookmark mark='g1b'/>Ten eigh times d is ten eigh d.
<bookmark mark='g2'/>B times ten c is ten b c, and b times d is b d.
<bookmark mark='h1'/>Next take negative five eigh plus b times c plus d.
<bookmark mark='h2'/>Negative five eigh times c and d gives negative five eigh c, and negative five eigh d.
The b gives b c plus b d.

beats.colours: the two x pieces in one colour
narration: <bookmark mark='k1'/>Step four, take three minus x times x minus six. Three times x is three x.
Three times negative six is negative eighteen.
<bookmark mark='k2'/>Negative x times x is negative x squared.
Negative x times negative six is plus six x.
<bookmark mark='k3'/>Three x and six x add to nine x.
The result is negative x squared plus nine x minus eighteen.

marks.n2: z × y = yz and z × 9 = 9z are written

narration: <bookmark mark='n1'/>Step five, take five plus z times y plus nine. Five times y is five y, and five times nine is forty five.
<bookmark mark='n2'/>Z times y is y z, and z times nine is nine z.
<bookmark mark='n3'/>Written neatly, it is five y plus y z plus nine z plus forty five.

marks.put: u = 2 and v = 5 are put in

narration: <bookmark mark='put'/>Step six, check the first one. Put u as two and v as five.
<bookmark mark='left'/>The original gives five times two, which is ten.
<bookmark mark='right'/>The result gives fifteen, minus six, plus ten, minus nine, which is ten too.

marks.pay: the words every term multiplies every term, and each sign stays with its term appear
marks.a1: the first two results are boxed

narration: <bookmark mark='pay'/>Every term multiplies every term, and each sign stays with its term.
<bookmark mark='a1'/>The first is three v minus three u plus u v minus nine. The second is ten plus four eigh.
<bookmark mark='a3'/>The third is one hundred eigh c, plus ten eigh d, plus ten b c, plus b d.
<bookmark mark='a4'/>The fourth is negative x squared, plus nine x, minus eighteen.
<bookmark mark='a5'/>The fifth is negative five eigh c, minus five eigh d, plus b c, plus b d.
<bookmark mark='a6'/>The sixth is five y, plus y z, plus nine z, plus forty five.
